issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

k8sServiceAccount.description:
Name of Service Account that backs the entity (Apps, Envs) for RBAC
Has to be pre-created

providerType.description:
Provider type for this security profile. Used by {@link #inst} to determine which
CloudSecurityProfile subtype (Aws, Azure, Gcp, or OnPrem) to return.

If set to a specific provider type (AWS, AZURE, GCP, or ONPREM), {@link #inst} will return
the corresponding subtype profile. If not specified, {@link #inst} will infer the provider type
from the Kubernetes cluster type (GKE, AKS, EKS).

oidcProvider.description:
It is a unique identifier for the cluster. To use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles for service
accounts, an IAM OIDC provider must exist for your cluster’s OIDC issuer URL.

accountId.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) account id for this CloudSecurityProfile.Aws.
This is the globally unique identifier of your project where the {@link oidcProvider} has been created or
will be created.

title:
This config is the mapping between the aws cloud identity and the k8s service account for enabling workload identity
This config controls the k8s serviceAccount tied to the apps based on the
cloudCluster hierarchy the config is present.
